blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: The chapter provides an overview of sports culture and history in Gujarat.
Section 8.1 focuses specifically on Cricket in Gujarat.
Section 8.2 examines various other sports prominent within the state.
Sardar Patel Stadium (Narendra Modi Stadium): Motera, Ahmedabad — world's largest cricket stadium (capacity 1,32,000). Renamed in 2020.
Gujarat Cricket Association (GCA): Affiliated to BCCI; manages cricket in Gujarat.
Gujarat Titans: IPL franchise; won IPL title in their debut season 2022.
Notable cricketers: Jasprit Bumrah, Hardik Pandya, Krunal Pandya, Axar Patel, Cheteshwar Pujara (Rajkot), Parthiv Patel.
Questions often focus on key cricket developments, famous players, and venues in Gujarat.
Be prepared for questions covering state government initiatives regarding traditional and non-cricket sports.
Kabaddi: Gujarat Fortunegiants — Pro Kabaddi League team.
Wrestling: Traditional kushti (wrestling) prominent in Saurashtra.
Traditional Sports: Tug of war, Gilli-danda, Kho-Kho are popular rural sports.
